# Create Dummy Bot

Source: [4341](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4341); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Create Dummy Bot](../../api/actions/create-dummy-bot.md).

<a id="wiki-4341-n1"></a>

- Dummy bots act only through Workshop actions; creation needs an available slot and -1 chooses first available.

<a id="wiki-4341-n2"></a>

- All team works only in free-for-all, explicit team values only in team modes.

<a id="wiki-4341-n3"></a>

- Archive states baseline limits of 6 per team or 12 FFA regardless of lobby settings, with extra-bot extensions available.

<a id="wiki-4341-n4"></a>

- Passing multiple heroes selects one randomly.

Source limitations:

- Baseline player/bot slot limits are date-sensitive; page updated 2024-11-26.
